column1: # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025-2026 Evgenij Cjura and project contributors
# The web UI is embedded in the app image (tools/pack_spa.py)
# update replaces firmware and UI together; there is no `spa` partition.
# Changing this layout needs one full USB flash (erase)
# No phy_init: that partition stores WiFi PHY calibration data
# build has no radio on the host at all.
# the bootloader 0x2000-0xC000; nvs follows it and ota_0 stays at 0x20000.
# it with nvs_open_from_partition() and abort()s inside esp_zigbee_init if that
# fails -- a boot loop with no error message. IDF's own bundled zigbee examples
# declare `fat` because they are still v1.x (esp_zb_* API).
